headline: Public hearings on the planBTV New North End neighborhood plan and CDO Amendment ZA-27-03 on natural resource overlay updates.
summary: The Planning Commission will hold a public hearing on the planBTV New North End neighborhood plan and a public hearing on proposed CDO Amendment ZA-27-03 regarding Natural Resource Overlay Updates. Staff will also share a summary of the 9/28 City Council Work Session on Overdose Prevention Centers.
